Name: Drawberry's Cute Festival Outfits for SVE
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b][u]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/u][/b]

[size=3][b][u]This mod is compatible with SCA SVE. This is NOT replacing Poltergeister’s SCA SVE mod. This is an add on which provides extra outfits for NPC’s who didn’t get festival outfits.[/u][/b]

﻿Oh hi!

If you’re a Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic lover like me and have also been missing Poltergeister’s brilliant work, here’s a matching mod for the SVE bachelors and bachelorettes!

[b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]configurable noses[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]configurable older Sophia overlay[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]unique festival outfits for each bachelor and bachelorette added by SVE[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]﻿This mod REQUIRES Stardew Valley Expanded, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 

I RECOMMEND you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's Vanilla SCC mod[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SVE SCC[/url] mod for a unified look!
﻿
Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]download the mod[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it. 
I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps!

If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url]! I'd really appreciate it :)[/size]
[size=3]
I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care,
Drawberry xo

Special thanks to:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]FlashShifter﻿[/url]﻿ for his permissions and for SVE﻿![/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister [/url]﻿for her permissions, the original portraits and sprites, and SCA work![/size][/size][/*]
[/list]
